description: Status and counters of one audience enrollment run started with enroll_sequence_audience. Poll while status is queued or running.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sequence_audience_enrollment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sequence_audience_enrollment` MCP tool.

audienceEnrollment.description: Audience enrollment run: id, status (queued, running, completed, cancelled, failed), estimatedCount, processedCount, enrolledCount, skippedCount, data (run-level values read as {{enrollment.*}}, or null), error and timestamps. includedSubscriberCount gives the number of hand-picked contacts; audience.includedSubscriberIds lists at most the first 20, with includedSubscriberIdsTruncated true when cut.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
